findings.claim: The kmctl check help still says it only checks that docs/ and .okf/ indexes agree with their folders. It does not mention the new prototype README.md check, and that help is the text an agent reads before it runs the command. The first line of the checks.py module docstring has the same gap.

verdict.text: check_prototypes does what the plan asks.
It flags each visible folder directly under .okf/prototypes/ that has no README.md, under check name prototype.
It skips files, hidden folders and deeper folders, and it returns nothing when there is no prototypes/ folder.
It runs from run_checks.
The tests cover all three rows and would fail if the behavior broke.
One docs gap is left in the command help, and a plain fix will do.
Ran loopctl gate stamp from the worktree: lint, format and tests passed, and rows r1, r2 and r3 passed.
Result: "stamp green: e42789ab1dd5a7d7e6254e44bee2dbd05060f12a5458de0faf11406e39b49146".
The change is staged but not committed in the worktree, so git diff main...HEAD is empty.
I reviewed the staged diff.
Read checks.py in full.
No duplicate finding: _section_concepts already leaves out prototype folders with no README.md, so the index check does not report the same folder a second time.
check_prototypes still runs when check_okf returns early because .okf/index.md is missing, which is fine.
r1: test_prototype_check_passes checks for exit 0 and no prototype findings on a fixture with a linked prototype.
r2: test_prototype_check_ignores_nested_folders adds speed/results/ and speed/src/ with no README.md and checks for no prototype findings.
A version that walked into nested folders would flag those two folders, so the test would catch it.
r3: test_prototype_check_fails_without_readme checks for exit 1 and that the prototype-check findings are exactly [".okf/prototypes/bare"].
Consistency: the new line in the module docstring matches docs-layout.md (a prototype is one folder, .okf/prototypes/<name>/, with its README.md).
There is no docs/ tree in this repo to update.
f1 (docs, non-blocking): the help for kmctl check (the command docstring at src/kmctl/__init__.py:116) and the first line of the checks.py docstring describe only the index checks.
They should also say that each prototype folder needs a README.md.
It is non-blocking because the fix is a one-line wording change with no behavior risk.
